market_summary.trend: BTC ~$63K as of 06:08 UTC Aug 1 (Saturday). Down ~3% (24h). Price below 20-day MA, trading inside descending channel after rejection near upper boundary ($65,000). Fear & Greed Index at 28 (Fear zone). August historically the worst month for BTC (-7.87% median, red 2022-2025).
market_summary.sentiment: Bearish lean. 39% bullish / 61% non-bullish sentiment. Whale wallets (1,000-10,000 BTC) accumulated ~66,700 BTC over 60 days, but mid-tier holders dumped ~77,800 BTC — net negative. ETF flows remain inconsistent with record outflows in Q4 2025.
market_summary.macro: FOMC concluded Jul 28-29: rates held at 3.50-3.75% (3 hawkish dissenters). Next FOMC: Sep 15-16. Today is Saturday — no US economic releases. Key upcoming: ISM PMI Aug 3 (Monday), NFP Aug 7 (Friday), CPI Aug 12 (Wednesday). Goldman Sachs spot BTC ETF decision delayed to Aug 21. Strategy (MicroStrategy) reported $8.22B net Q2 loss on BTC holdings (Jul 30).
market_summary.macro_regime: Rates-sensitive environment. BTC correlated with risk assets. Hawkish Fed tone (3 dissenters at Jul FOMC) applying pressure. Weekend session = lower liquidity = elevated volatility risk.
market_summary.nfp_watch: Next major catalyst: NFP Aug 7 at 12:30 UTC. Strong jobs = hawkish pressure bearish for BTC. Weak jobs = dovish pivot bets bullish for BTC. Current rate: 3.50-3.75%.
